children: Texas Capital Bancshares said it plans to transfer its primary listing to the Texas Stock Exchange from Nasdaq
The financial services firm's stock will begin trading as a TXSE-listed company beginning Oct. 8 under the ticker symbol TCBI and change to TXCP in November.
The company said its decision to list on TXSE reflects the successful completion of its transformation and represents the natural next step for a Texas-founded, Texas-headquartered institution.

The Texas Stock Exchange began offering trading in U.S.-listed stocks in July. Last week, The Wall Street Journal reported pipeline company Energy Transfer was the first major company to switch its primary listing to TXSE from the New York Stock Exchange.
TXSE launched in 2024 and its founder James Lee aimed to capitalize on state politicians' efforts to elevate Texas in the business world, the Journal reported.
